profile.name: Yoko Fajar Santosa
profile.headline: IT Infrastructure Specialist & Web Systems Builder
about: I work as an IT Staff specializing in infrastructure, server administration, networking, system maintenance, and reliable digital services.
My work focuses on building, maintaining, and improving IT infrastructure and information systems, with an emphasis on reliability, security, performance, automation, and operational efficiency.

research.narrative: I am interested in building reliable IT environments where servers, networks, applications, databases, and automation work together efficiently. My focus includes infrastructure management, system monitoring, deployment, backup, security, performance optimization, and practical automation.
